terrain.title: Terrain — Taxi-v4
terrain.help: Live Taxi-v4 map: taxi position, passenger(s) and destination.

play.help_demo: Runs the demo with the selected pre-trained agent (frozen model, pure exploitation, no learning).
play.help_train: Start, pause or stop the simulation with the selected agent and parameters.

speed.title: SPEED
speed.help: Adjusts simulation speed from Slow (0.4s/step) to Max (no delay, 1 frame/25).

agent.help: Select the algorithm (Q-Learning, SARSA, Monte Carlo, DQN, random or heuristic) and the 1 or 2 passenger mode.

saved.title: My agents
saved.help: Save a trained tabular agent (Q-table) to localStorage or a file (max 4 slots), then select it in demo mode to replay it.
saved.noModel: Train a tabular agent (Q-Learning, SARSA, Monte Carlo) to be able to save it.
saved.importFailed: Import failed (invalid file or slots full)

layouts.title: My layouts
layouts.help: Save the current grid arrangement (components and positions) to localStorage or a file (max 4 slots), then click a slot to reload it.
layouts.importFailed: Import failed (invalid file or slots full)

hyper.help_train: Configures the hyperparameters for the next run. Each panel keeps its own values, except the episode count which is shared across all panels.
hyper.help_demo: In demo mode the agent uses its frozen pre-trained model. Only the number of demo episodes and the seed are adjustable. The episode count is shared across all panels.
hyper.nextDemo: Applied to the next demo run.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.help: Live metrics: episode, step, cumulative reward, epsilon, explore/exploit mode and last action.

qtable.title: Q-table
qtable.help: Q-table heatmap: rows = states, columns = actions. Blue = negative value, grey ≈ zero, yellow = positive. Highlighted row = current state.

network.title: Neural network
network.help: DQN network graph: Embedding → Hidden → Output. Nodes coloured by activation, edges by weight (yellow=positive, blue=negative). DQN only.
network.subtitle: Embedding → Hidden → Output

reward.title: Reward / episode
reward.help: Cumulative reward per episode. Tends to increase as the agent learns.

steps.title: Steps / episode
steps.help: Number of steps per episode. A high-performing agent uses fewer.

epsilon.title: Epsilon / episode
epsilon.help: Epsilon decay: gradual shift from exploration to exploitation.

totalSteps.title: Total steps
totalSteps.help: Total number of steps taken across the entire training run.

reward.title: Avg reward
reward.help: Average reward per episode since the start of training.

epsilon.title: Epsilon (ε)
epsilon.help: Current exploration rate; decreases as learning progresses.

avgSteps.title: Avg steps
avgSteps.help: Average number of steps per episode; decreases as the policy improves.

maxReward.title: Max reward
maxReward.help: Best reward achieved in a single episode since the start.

minSteps.title: Min steps
minSteps.help: Smallest number of steps completed in a single episode.

performance.title: Agent performance
performance.help: Episode success rate and distribution of actions taken by the agent, updated in real time.

chrono.title: Chrono
chrono.help: Time elapsed since the current simulation started.

about.title: Taxi Driver
about.description: An agent learns to drive a taxi in the Taxi-v4 environment: pick up the passenger and drop them off in as few steps as possible, guided by rewards.
